blocking.title: AI nuclear targeting ignores the civilians it kills: hydrogen bombs on cities at the utility floor, the same city struck again and again. Seed 4877: Germany H-bombs Shanghai for 3,802,105 dead and 105 soldiers at utility 0.025 (NUKE_FLOOR exactly). Seed 8693: the United States H-bombs Paris three times (3,178,766, 1,404,231 and 609,000 dead; utilities 0.026, 0.073, 0.026), then Rome (3,720,550 dead, 11,550 soldiers, 0.091). Seed 9437: Tashkent struck 6 times and Banda Aceh 6 times by three nations. 25 of 58 AI bursts on 14 worlds kill over 10 times more civilians than soldiers.
evidence: src/sim/systems/nuclear.ts:554-560 (nuclearUtility: no term for people killed)
blocking.fix: Make the people a burst kills a cost in the utility (scaled by doctrine and outrage), so that a strike whose military value is at the floor never takes a city of millions. Choose the yield by the target, so an army in the field is not hit with a hydrogen bomb that also kills a city. Do not strike a city already struck in the same war unless it holds new value.

blocking.title: The war at sea is over after year 1. Year 1 has a mean of 38 sea battles a world; years 2 to 30 have 2.7 a world-year (1,090 in 406 world-years). 50 to 96 armed fleets stay afloat (115 at the start), but at the year-10 and year-20 samples, 18 of 28 have no war whose two sides both have a navy.
blocking.fix: Make the naval powers' wars with each other, and with coastal enemies, bring their fleets out after year 1 (blockades, raids, escort fights, landings), or stop presenting naval warfare as a running feature. Measure it as sea battles per world-year in years 2 to 30, against year 1.

blocking.title: The air war is a year-1 feature and cannot be seen up close. Air battles fall from a mean of 2,537 in year 1 to 122 a year after it (14 worlds). No sortie is drawn at 25 or 10 m/px over a front in contact (0 in every probe, seed 7019). On day 10 of Germany–Poland the air map shows one German zone from London to Kiev, and every hover reads 'held by Germany'.
blocking.fix: Draw the sorties over a front at T3; split the air map into zones a player can read as fronts; keep the late air war in proportion to the late land war (PLAN 7.29 and 7.36), measured per world-year after year 1.
